mapper.select: SELECT sir.*, si.name AS supply_name, si.code AS supply_code, u.real_name AS operator_name FROM stock_in_record sir LEFT JOIN supply_item si ON sir.supply_id = si.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON sir.operator_id = u.id WHERE sir.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_in_record (supply_id, batch_no, quantity, unit_price, total_price, production_date, expiry_date, supplier, operator_id, remark) VALUES (#{supplyId}, #{batchNo}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalPrice}, #{productionDate}, #{expiryDate}, #{supplier}, #{operatorId}, #{remark})
